summary.root_cause_text: The orders database is read-only ('attempt to write a readonly database'), so POST /orders and the ledger sync fail. The cause is unknown and is outside the tools I have (filesystem permissions, disk, or a DB mount or file-state issue).
recommended: Have a human check why the DB is read-only: file and mount permissions, disk full or filesystem remounted read-only, and the SQLite file or journal ownership. Restore write access.
After write access is back, run check_invariants and check_data_integrity. Reprocess any unpaid orders and let the sync catch up.
Do not roll back. The v1.3 deploy is 26h old and unrelated to this failure. Config changes (worker, queue) won't help either.
